messages:
jorge_new: Hi — first day. Two quick issues: Okta MFA push never arrives and the onboarding Drive link opened my personal account (shows 'Request access'). Also trying to add an authenticator app QR but it says 'invalid QR'. Who should I ping?
sam-it: Welcome! @it-identity for provisioning/Drive. For MFA: did you set up Okta Verify or using TOTP app? Which device?
jorge_new: Trying to add Google Authenticator on Pixel 6. Okta Verify setup never sent push — I only see 'Waiting for activation' spinner. QR was from the onboarding page.
it-identity: I see your SCIM provisioning completed but the Drive folder wasn't shared because your Google profile was ambiguous. I pushed a direct share to jorge@redwood.com. Check drive again.
okta-bot: Okta: Activation email sent to jorge@redwood.com at 1769999500.
jorge_new: Drive works now, thanks. Still can't get Okta Verify push. QR still gives 'invalid QR' in Google Authenticator.
sam-it: For Okta Verify push you need to open the activation link from the Okta email on the device you want pushes on (or use Okta Verify app to scan the QR). For TOTP (Google Authenticator) the QR from the browser may be encoded for Okta Verify only. Try the 'Setup another way' link in Okta and choose 'TOTP' if available.
jorge_new: I used the email link on my laptop then tried to scan with Pixel camera pointing at laptop screen — failed. I then saved the QR as PNG and opened it on my phone but Authenticator still says invalid.
maria-devex: Some phones blur screen QR. Zoom the QR to full size on desktop, then scan. Also try copying the secret key (there's usually a 'set up manually' option with the code).
it-identity: I just regenerated an alternate TOTP secret for your account and enabled manual setup. It was a provisioning hiccup where Okta issued an Okta Verify-only QR. Try the manual secret: OTP secret: V4RND-EXAMPLE-SECRET (paste into Authenticator manually).
jorge_new: Manual secret worked, codes are showing. Okta Verify push still missing though.
sam-it: Push requires your device to be fully registered. If you want push, install Okta Verify on Pixel, then in Okta click 'Add factor' -> 'Okta Verify' -> 'Set up' and follow the mobile link. Or use the activation QR from the mobile email.
jorge_new: Installed Okta Verify and clicked mobile activation link — it shows a code on the app but Okta on desktop still times out when I click 'Verify'. Any network tips?
maria-devex: Network timeouts can block the push response. Try disabling Wi‑Fi and use mobile data, or vice versa. Also ensure date/time is correct on phone and laptop.
jorge_new: Switched phone to cellular only and tried again — push came through! Registration complete.
it-identity: Great. I also resent the 1Password invite to jorge@redwood.com; please accept and save recovery codes there. Company policy: save MFA backups in the company vault and mark restricted if needed.
jorge_new: Accepted 1Password and saved codes. Big help, thanks everyone :rocket:
